text:
Alex H: Heads up 1: GatewayX flagged they9re getting marketplace demo leads in EU and think they should own outreach. Who9s actually responsible?

Maria C: As we9ve been handling it: marketplace -> BizDev/SDR owns initial contact. If partner requests SI-led technical discovery, we hand off. GatewayX claim sounds like they want entitlement on introduction.

Samir P: Are these marketplace discovery forms or partner referrals? That determines entitlement policy.

Alex H: It9s the demo request flow (marketplace listing -> choose partner). Partner tag = GatewayX.

Jordan (SI Ops): Per GatewayX MSA they9re allowed to do technical discovery for introduced accounts, but Redwood must control contract routing. Suggest simple rule: if account ARR < 250k EUR -> SI can lead initial POC; otherwise Redwood SDR handles qualification first. Keeps legal/contract path tidy.

Kevin BD: Agree. Add a 48-hour outreach SLA: BizDev/SDR must attempt contact within 48h of lead creation, otherwise partner may claim the lead. That reduces stale leads.

Maria C: I9ll build a Confluence mapping table (columns: region, partner, ARR_threshold, default_owner, exceptions). I can seed EU/APAC.

Samir P: Add risk annotations: NDA_needed, data_residency, on_prem_hw. GatewayX = on_prem_hw flagged. We should also capture partner_proof_url for claimed introductions.

Alex H: For co-marketing/announcements, enforce a 2-week prep and product sign-off before publish. We call it "announce gating". Enterprise strategic exceptions allowed but require PM+BizDev signoff.

Jordan (SI Ops): Draft routing pseudo-code: 
- if (marketplace_lead && partner_tagged) assign_to = BizDev_primary;
- if (no_outreach_in_48h) partner_allowed_to_claim = true;
- if (account_ARR < partner_threshold) assign_to = SI_field_team;
- if (border_case(within 20% of threshold)) route_to = #partnerships-triage for human review

Kevin BD: Can we require partners to upload timestamped proof (screenshot of marketplace lead card) when they claim? That cuts disputes.

Maria C: Will include an intake template + sample screenshot on the Confluence page. Also a short FAQ: "how to claim" and "what counts as introduced".

Samir P: Add an audit column: claim_proof_url and a required freeform field: "how we verified intro". Also instruct CS to cc partner rep on initial outreach email when partner claims.

Alex H: Action items: Maria 15 5 create Confluence page + intake template by Friday; Jordan 15 update SI Ops playbook with threshold examples and routing pseudo-code; Kevin 15 loop in Legal re: GatewayX MSA carveouts; Samir 15 add risk flag taxonomy and audit fields; I9ll create #partnerships-triage and ping this group. :thumbsup:

announce-bot: Reminder 1 5 Partnership sync tomorrow 10:00am PT - https://cal.redwood/integrations

Alex H: Thanks team. Let9s make the Confluence schema as machine-readable as possible so we can wire it into intake automation later.

Maria C: Noted 5 will include CSV/JSON export example and sample Zapier/webhook payload for marketplace leads.

Jordan (SI Ops): One more: add an escalation path for contested claims (2-step: partnership ops review, then Legal arbitration for high ARR deals).

Samir P: Logging: keep a copy of the marketplace lead card + timestamps in audit. We can backfill last 30 days to see if this is recurring.

Kevin BD: I9ll reach out to GatewayX legal this afternoon.

Alex H: Closing loop: we9ll treat this as a policy pilot for 30 days. If anything else crops up, escalate in #partnerships-triage.
